prompt: This queue keeps an inbox and an outbox. `dequeue` pops from the outbox, and when it is empty it first moves everything from the inbox over (reversing it). What does each `dequeue` return?
explain: Reversing the inbox into the outbox turns last-in-first-out into first-in-first-out. `4` waits in the inbox until the outbox is empty, so `2` and `3` come out first.
